title: Survey version published
description: A Tenant published an immutable new version of a survey. A link issued before the publish keeps answering with the version it opened, so a receiver must use `version_id` and never assume the survey's current version. This schema describes the `data` member; the envelope is described in ../../messaging/README.md.

version_no.description: The version's number within the survey, starting at 1. Unique per survey and never reused.

question_ids.description: Every question id the version carries, so a consumer of `survey-response.submitted` can tell which questions a response could contain without fetching the version. Ids are stable across versions; a question whose type changed gets a new id.

published_at.description: When the version became immutable, in UTC.
